source: 市政府宣布，新的地铁线路将于明年三月正式开通。
target: The city government announced that the new subway line will officially opens in March next year.
context: From a news article about the expansion of the city's public transport network.

source: 由于台风影响，所有航班已被取消，旅客可申请全额退款。
target: Due to the typhoon, all flights have been cancelled and passengers may apply for a 50% refund.
context: From an airline's travel advisory issued during typhoon season.

source: 这家公司去年的营业收入增长了百分之十五。
target: The company's revenue fell by fifteen percent last year.
context: From a business report summarizing the company's annual results.

source: 研究人员表示，这种新药在早期试验中显示出良好效果。
target: Researchers said the new 药物 showed promising results in early trials.
context: From a health section article on experimental treatments.

source: 会议将于下周五上午九点在北京举行。
target: The meeting will be held in Beijing at 9 a.m. on next Friday.
context: From a diplomatic news brief about upcoming trade talks.

source: 他强调，保护环境是每个公民的责任。
target: He stressed that protect the environment is every citizens responsibility.
context: From coverage of a government press conference on environmental policy.

source: The museum will remain closed until further notice.
target: Das Museum bleibt bis auf Weiteres geschlossen bleiben.
context: From a city culture newsletter announcing renovation work.

source: Tickets cost twelve dollars for adults and six dollars for children.
target: Tickets kosten zwölf Dollar für Erwachsene und sechzehn Dollar für Kinder.
context: From a tourism website's page describing museum admission prices.

source: Please contact our support team if you have any questions.
target: Bitte kontaktieren Sie unser Support-Team, wenn du Fragen hast.
context: From a software company's customer service page; the rest of the document uses formal address (Sie).

source: The conference was postponed to October 3, 2025.
target: Die Konferenz wurde auf den 10/3/2025 verschoben.
context: From an academic society's announcement about its annual meeting.
